seed: Objects of type `target` under action ACTION3 with touching neighbours [player,reflection,wall,wall,wall] show mixed outcomes: no_change x1, pixels x1, h,pixels,y x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: state accumulated across earlier steps that the frame does not show. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Colour-derived 21x21 board of 3x3 cells; axes 10, players 5, targets 11.
ACTION5 cycles horizontal axis, vertical axis, then players in reading order.
Arrows move the selected axis/player; board edges and other players block player movement.
Both single-axis mirrors and the double mirror render as 4; target centres persist through holes; effective actions tick the HUD.
All 44 transitions pass statelessly, so the hidden-history hypothesis is unnecessary; click and undo behaviour are unconfirmed.
